title: Add rekty to the allowlist
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt:
Add rekty and rodrigookk to the allowlist
Closes #13440
Closes #13444

gist.headline: Two More Bees Enter
gist.blurb: rekty and rodrigookk have been added to the GitHub allowlist. The garden gate recognizes two more familiar faces.
gist.summary: Added the GitHub accounts rekty and rodrigookk to the shared authentication allowlist.
gist.impact: rekty and rodrigookk can now access the allowlist-gated Pollinations workflows without manual intervention.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden gate represents the shared GitHub authentication allowlist, with Polli acting as a friendly gatekeeper and two small labeled visitor badges being welcomed in. Code-plants and a softly glowing terminal make the internal access configuration legible without making it feel like a security warning.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown stripes, pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gatekeeper cap, welcoming two small visitor badges labeled “rekty” and “rodrigookk” through a garden gate beside a lime green (#ecf874) glowing terminal and code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: “ALLOWLIST”.
